meridian_ui.codex.title: Technique codex
meridian_ui.action.storage_hint: Solid fill shows stored qi. The pale segment shows qi in transit.
meridian_ui.notice.opening_timeout: No response yet. Check the current state and try again.
meridian_ui.notice.breathing_unavailable: Breathing is unavailable. Check the host connection.
meridian_ui.notice.breathing_locked: Use a Gathering Fragment to unlock breathing and automatic breathing. Fragments can be found in dungeon and mineshaft chests.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.part_hp:
Part health. Hearts show the combined health of all parts.
Natural regeneration, healing and regeneration potions only restore parts above zero.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.strength:
Force available at full health. Injury and fatigue reduce it.
Arm strength affects melee strikes and punches. Leg strength affects kicks.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.burst:
Maximum power for one action. Injury and fatigue reduce it.
A move that exceeds it cannot deliver its full force.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.endurance: Work available before exhaustion. Movement also uses this reserve.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.occupied: Actions using this tissue. Fatigue only recovers while idle.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.recovery: Time for fatigue to halve while idle. Zero means there is no passive recovery.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.tissue_hp:
Tissue damage does not heal naturally or through ordinary healing.
Bitter Yellow Salve treats limb bone, muscle and skin. At zero, the tissue produces no force.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.tissue_fatig: Fatigue reduces force. At maximum fatigue the tissue cannot produce force. Rest allows recovery.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.organ_rate: Maximum qi this organ can send or receive per second.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.organ_hp:
Organ damage does not heal naturally or through ordinary healing.
At zero, the organ cannot transfer or refine qi.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.buffer: Stored qi and capacity. The buffer empties on death.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.meridian_rat: Maximum qi flow through this meridian per second.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.resilience: Meridian strength used when opening it.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.lumen:
Available qi and lumen capacity. Techniques and opening draw from the lumen.
Widening a meridian increases its capacity.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.wall: Reserve stored in the wall. It fuels realm breakthroughs and empties on death.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.meridian_fat: No current rule uses this value.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.condition:
Only intact meridians transfer qi. Leaking or severed meridians cannot currently be repaired.
Excessive circulation thrust can cause a leak.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.stage: Opened meridians allow circulation and provide qi for techniques.
meridian_ui.inspection.hint.progress: How much of this meridian has been opened.
meridian_ui.inspection.missing_target: This target is no longer part of the body
meridian_ui.inspection.disabled: Disabled. Muscles cannot exert force, organs cannot transfer qi, and techniques using them are unavailable.
meridian_ui.inspection.disabled_help: Healing cannot restore a part at zero health. A Totem of Undying restores each part to 25%. Respawning restores each part to 10%.
meridian_ui.breath.tip.buffer: Breathing organs: %s qi · In transit: %s qi
meridian_ui.failure.operation.revision_c: Body state changed. Wait for the action to refresh.
meridian_ui.failure.opening.insufficient: Insufficient lumen reserves. Breathe to replenish qi.
meridian_ui.failure.opening.opening_busy: Another meridian is being opened. Pause it first.
meridian_ui.failure.opening.opening_requ: Check reserves, organ stamina and focus.
meridian_ui.failure.opening.opening_not_: No meridian opening is in progress.
meridian_ui.failure.opening.revision_con: Body state changed. Check the latest values.
meridian_ui.failure.opening.access_denie: You cannot operate on this body.
meridian_ui.failure.opening.module_unava: Check the affected meridian, organ or route.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.capacity_e: The organ or meridian is full. Wait for a transfer or widen the meridian.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.insufficie: Insufficient material. Change recipe or location.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.environmen: The local supply is in use. Try again later.
The environment cannot supply qi. Refresh and try again.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.module_una: Check the affected organ or route.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.meridian_u: Open the source meridian before drawing qi.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.revision_c: Body state changed. Refresh and select again.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.organ_busy: A task is already in progress.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.throughput: The route is at capacity. Try again later.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.pending_ti: A body event is pending. Refresh shortly.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.access_den: You cannot operate on this body.
meridian_ui.failure.gathering.recipe_inc: This recipe is unavailable. Refresh the list.
meridian_ui.notice.missing_body: Waiting for body data and models
meridian_ui.notice.opening_unavailable: Opening rules or controls are unavailable for this meridian.
meridian_ui.action.controls:
F: Focus on the selected meridian
G: Gather qi / pause
meridian_ui.breath.auto_help:
Pauses below %s stamina and resumes at %s.
Uses breathing stamina at %s of manual efficiency.
meridian_ui.breath.rotate: Middle-drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
meridian_ui.breath.automatic_hint: Automatic breathing · Middle-drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
meridian_ui.breath.manual_hint: Left to inhale · Right to exhale · Middle-drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom
meridian_ui.breath.instructions:
Hold left to inhale or right to exhale. Release to stop.
Middle-drag to rotate and scroll to zoom. Airflow affects nearby aura more strongly.
Exhale when your lungs are full. Watch your stamina and focus.
meridian_ui.inspection.title: Inspect
meridian_ui.inspection.select: Select part of the model to view its description and readings
meridian_ui.inspection.hint: Click to select · Drag to turn · Scroll to zoom · Middle-click to reset
meridian_ui.inspection.locked_hint: Use an Inner Vision scroll to inspect your body. Find one in a dungeon, mineshaft, desert pyramid or jungle temple chest. Skeletons sometimes carry one.
meridian_ui.aura.unavailable: There is no aura to gather here
meridian_ui.aura.overworld: Aura is only present in the Overworld.
meridian_ui.aura.supply: Shared supply: up to %s units per second
meridian_ui.aura.thresholds: Thin below %s, rich at %s or above
meridian_ui.aura.waiting: Open the breathing window to see the local aura.
meridian_ui.combat.stance_hint: Press %s to enter combat stance, then press a slot number to use its technique
meridian_ui.combat.drag_hint: Drag in a technique to assign it · Right-click to clear
meridian_ui.settings.protected: The original configuration is protected. Changes cannot be saved.
meridian_ui.settings.lock_hint: When enabled, the mouse turns both the camera and your character. When disabled, you can look around freely. Target lock takes priority.
meridian_ui.settings.recording: Press a key. Esc cancels and Backspace clears the binding.
meridian_ui.settings.key_updated: Key binding changed. Save to apply.
meridian_ui.settings.invalid_radius: Enter a distance between 1 and 128 blocks.
meridian_ui.settings.camera_move: Use the movement keys to move closer, farther away or sideways.
meridian_ui.settings.camera_height: Jump raises the camera, sneak lowers it, and Esc cancels.
meridian_ui.settings.camera_clipped: An obstacle has moved the camera closer. Saving keeps the chosen distance.
meridian_ui.settings.preview_ended: Preview ended. Camera settings were not saved.
meridian_ui.combat.select:

meridian_ui.data.help: Data tab: total qi, element makeup and per-meridian details; hover for explanations, click a row for details.
meridian_ui.data.column.name: Meridian
meridian_ui.data.empty.no_rows: No meridian data has arrived yet.
meridian_ui.data.empty.unopened: No meridian is open yet. Pick one on the Meridians tab to start opening it; its qi will show up here.
meridian_ui.data.tip.total: All qi held in meridian lumens and walls; organ buffers and qi in transit are not included.
meridian_ui.data.tip.account:
%s: %s yuan held; at the current average density it can hold %s yuan.
The bar shows volume used: %s.
meridian_ui.data.tip.phase:
%s: %s yuan, %s of meridian qi.
Phases are sorted by the density of each portion of qi.
meridian_ui.data.tip.footer:
Organs: qi stored in organs or being processed.
In transit: qi that has left one meridian and not yet reached the next.
meridian_ui.data.tip.ring: Share of meridian qi by element; the centre names the largest.
meridian_ui.data.tip.column.name: Click a row to show that meridian's details; click again to hide them.
meridian_ui.data.tip.column.opening: Opening stage; meridians being opened show their progress.
meridian_ui.data.tip.column.lumen: Lumen: held / capacity in yuan; the thin bar shows volume used.
meridian_ui.data.tip.column.wall: Wall: held / capacity in yuan; the thin bar shows volume used.
meridian_ui.data.tip.column.density: Lumen qi divided by the lumen volume it occupies.
meridian_ui.data.tip.column.main: The element with the most qi across lumen and wall.
codex.hint.everyone_common: Common among any {entities} who has attained {realm}. Best them upon the road, and this scroll is readily turned up from their pockets.
codex.hint.everyone_rare: Known by every {entities} of {realm}, yet even after overcoming them, finding the scroll upon their person remains a rare thing.
codex.hint.some_common: Held only by a few {entities} who have attained {realm}, but should you overcome those who know it, the scroll is often found on them.
codex.hint.some_rare: Practiced by only a handful of {entities} at {realm}; even if you best them, you will rarely lay hands on their scroll.
codex.hint.wide_common: Known by most across the realm who have cultivated {realm}. Best them, and you will often recover this scroll from their effects.
codex.hint.wide_rare: Familiar to many beings across the realm who have reached {realm}, though even in victory, the scroll is rarely discovered upon them.
codex.hint.unknown: Lost to the four winds. Across all my wanderings, I have yet to hear of any living soul who has truly mastered this volume.
codex.hint.origin_foe: A scroll kept close by the foes of {origin}. When vengeance brings them to your door, vanquish them to claim it.
